title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25387v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%

translated_title: TuringSpace：通过交互式验证码在行动中落实空间智能
translated_abstract: 人类在视觉世界中行动的方式是：推断二维视图背后的三维布局，预测动作将如何改变它，并在看到结果后进行自我修正。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）也能做到这一点吗？验证码（CAPTCHA）提供了一个天然的测试场景，因为人类正是通过这一循环来解答验证码的：在屏幕上点击和拖动，并根据每次的结果进行调整。然而，现有的验证码基准大多已被解决，且很少涉及空间性；而空间类基准又很少需要实际行动。因此，我们提出了TuringSpace——一个包含125个交互式验证码的合成网络环境，这些验证码涵盖五种空间能力，必须通过屏幕上的点击和拖动来完成。每个任务都是一个程序，可以借助校验器和参考答案生成新的实例，因此这些任务也构成了一个可扩展的训练场。人类能解决94.1%的任务，而表现最好的模型GPT-6 Astra仍有25.9%的任务失败，最好的开源权重模型Kimi K3则失败了68.0%的任务。
tldr: 提出了TuringSpace——一个包含125个需通过点击和拖动完成的交互式验证码合成网络环境，用于评估多模态大模型在实际行动中落实空间智能的能力，人类解决率达94.1%，而最强模型仍失败25.9%，暴露出当前模型在行动性空间推理上的显著差距。
en_tdlr: We present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that must be solved through clicks and drags to test spatial intelligence in action, where humans achieve 94.1% success while the best model still fails 25.9% of tasks.
